newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Japan lends Morocco $154 mln for local projects.
newsitem.headline: Japan lends Morocco $154 mln for local projects.

text.p: Japan on Thursday granted Morocco a $154 million loan to build a highway and extend water grids of two cities on the coastal and eastern parts of the country, the finance ministry said.

In a statement, the ministry said a stake of $79 million will be earmarked to the 30 km (19 miles) highway linking Casablanca to neighbouring Settat town. The remainder would be devoted to water infrastructure to Safi city on the Atlantic coast and Oujda cities on the border with Algeria.
Kuwaiti Development Fund has also contributed $30 million for the Casablanca-Settat highway.
Japan granted Morocco loans worth more than $130 million since 1996 for water projects.
